q: Do I need an account to book?
a: No. You can search, book and pay as a guest. Everything you need to manage your appointment — reschedule, cancel, get directions — lives in a secure link in your confirmation email.

Each stylist sets their own deposit, usually 20–30% of the service price. You pay it at booking to secure your slot and pay the remaining balance at the salon. The exact amounts are shown before you confirm.

q: What if I need to cancel or reschedule?
a: You can cancel or reschedule free of charge up to each stylist’s cancellation window — typically 24 to 72 hours before your appointment. The window and any late fees are shown on the stylist’s profile and again before you pay.
It depends on the service. Every listing states clearly whether hair is included or you should bring your own — and it’s repeated in your confirmation email and reminders.

q: What does it cost to use Tiwára’s House?
a: Clients pay a small booking fee of £0.50 + 1.5% of the service price, itemised before you pay. Stylists pay nothing — no listing fee and no commission.
Card, Apple Pay or Google Pay, processed securely by Stripe. Your deposit is charged at booking; the balance is settled at the salon.

q: I’m a stylist — how do I get listed?
a: Onboarding takes about five minutes: your business details, the services you offer, and your availability. Listing is free, you keep 100% of your service price, and clients can book you the same day.
